_source: Compiled from the offline ER guide's quest notes (wiki.gg CC BY-SA + Fextralife, reworded). Spoiler-light: how to unlock each ending, not what happens in it.
howItWorks: After the final boss you choose an ending at Fractured Marika. Which choices appear depends on what you unlocked beforehand.
Mending Runes (from Fia, Goldmask, Dung Eater) each add one extra choice — you can carry all three and pick at the end.
Ranni's ending is chosen by summoning her blue sign instead of touching Marika.
The Frenzied Flame is different: once inherited it OVERRIDES everything unless you revert it with Miquella's Needle before the end. (verify exact override rules)

endings.name: Age of Fracture
endings.how: Beat the final boss and choose "Mend the Elden Ring" — no quest required.

endings.name: Age of Order
endings.how: Complete Brother Corhyn & Goldmask's quest and use the Mending Rune of Perfect Order at the end.
endings.pointOfNoReturn: The Law of Regression statue step in Leyndell must be done before the capital turns to ash.

endings.name: Age of the Duskborn
endings.how: Complete Fia's quest (through the Deathbed Dream) and use the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.
endings.pointOfNoReturn: Fia's chain depends on Rogier's and D's steps landing in order — start early.

endings.name: Blessing of Despair
endings.how: Complete Dung Eater's quest (5 Seedbed Curses) and use the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
endings.pointOfNoReturn: Killing him in the sewer gaol (for the Sword of Milos) forfeits the rune.

endings.name: Age of the Stars
endings.how: Complete Ranni's full quest, then summon her blue sign after the final boss instead of touching Marika.
endings.pointOfNoReturn: Giving Ranni Seluvis's Potion breaks the quest permanently.

endings.name: Lord of the Frenzied Flame
endings.how: Follow Hyetta's quest and inherit the Flame of Frenzy at the Frenzied Flame Proscription (armor off, through the sealed door).
endings.pointOfNoReturn: Inheriting the flame locks this ending. Reverting requires Miquella's Needle — built from Millicent's quest reward, usable only after beating Malenia, at Dragonlord Placidusax's arena. (verify)
